title: Empty and Structural Variants knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which principle is most useful when applying Empty and Structural Variants?
options: It removes the need to understand HTML semantics, the CSS cascade or browser behavior.
It makes every interface responsive and accessible without testing.
It runs all utility classes as JavaScript in the browser.
use styles that reflect actual component state and preserve usable focus indicators
questions.answer_key: use styles that reflect actual component state and preserve usable focus indicators
questions.explanation: Empty and Structural Variants is best understood through the syllabus topics: Empty elements, First and last children, Only-child styling. Choose the technique deliberately and verify the result.

questions.prompt: Which workflow is strongest when working with empty and structural variants?
options: Assume that starting a development server proves every page and state works.
Skip narrow-screen testing because utility-first CSS is automatically responsive.
test keyboard focus, disabled/selected states and reduced-motion preferences where relevant
Add classes until a screenshot looks acceptable without inspecting generated CSS.
questions.answer_key: test keyboard focus, disabled/selected states and reduced-motion preferences where relevant
questions.explanation: A reliable workflow checks generated CSS and the actual interface. Related topics include: Empty elements, First and last children, Only-child styling, Structural conditions.

questions.prompt: Which common mistake should you avoid when applying empty and structural variants?
options: Check keyboard states where controls are involved.
hover-only styling does not replace keyboard feedback or actual functionality
Document intended behavior and test representative content.
Use the official documentation for version-specific behavior.
questions.answer_key: hover-only styling does not replace keyboard feedback or actual functionality
questions.explanation: Good styling work is verified, version-aware and tested with realistic content and input methods.
